description: The CoachAIze write log of this tenant: every change DelegAIze sent to CoachAIze (each coachaize__ call the product does not mark read-only), newest first, with time, who/which agent, tool, record id, the record's name, payload hash and outcome: ok, failed (with the error) or queued (waiting for approval inside CoachAIze, with its pending id). Read it as it is — names are in the log. Read-only.

tool_name.description: Only entries of this coachaize__ tool
